acceptance: A second code-index truth set exists that does not come from go/types: hand-checked or gopls-derived callers, including interface-method calls and calls through function values.
evolve code bench scores every backend on both truth sets and prints precision, recall and p50/p95 per set.
fix: Add an independent truth set with interface methods so the gotypes backend is not graded only by the checker it is built on.
summary: The 40-symbol code-index truth set comes from go/types, the same checker the gotypes backend uses, so its 1.00/1.00 callers score is circular. The dossier proposes a second, independent truth set that includes interface methods before gotypes becomes the default route.
title: The code-index bench has a second truth set that go/types did not produce
